extracted.intended_audience: organization and individual federal grant applicants using Grants.gov (Workspace users)
extracted.subtask_description: A compilation of training videos, quick-tip clips, and help resources that teach applicants how to register, create and manage a Grants.gov Workspace, complete forms, add participants, and submit federal grant applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Grants.gov Video Series
rubrics_metrics.description: Covers the complete Grants.gov application process, from registering and creating a Grants.gov account to finding funding opportunities and completing an application package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended as a high-level, end-to-end overview of using Grants.gov to apply for federal grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Register with Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how to create a Grants.gov account so you can subscribe to funding opportunity notifications and apply for federal grants using Grants.gov Workspace; this video also explains how to associate a UEI with an applicant account (optional).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step-by-step account creation and optional UEI association instructions for applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intro to Grants.gov User Roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains applicant user roles within the Grants.gov system and how these roles impact the application process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers role definitions and impact on permissions/workflow within Workspace.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Search for a Federal Grant on Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Shows Grants.gov's search engine capabilities and how users can find and apply for federal grants in various ways; also demonstrates subscribing to opportunity notifications generated from saved search criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes tips for saved searches and notifications for registered users.

rubrics_metrics.name: What's in a Grant Opportunity on Grants.gov?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the information that is included with every posting of a federal grant opportunity on Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps applicants understand opportunity notices and where to find key details (eligibility, deadlines, application package).

rubrics_metrics.name: Intro to Applying on Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: An introduction showing how to apply for a federal grant using Grants.gov Workspace and emphasizing the ease of the apply process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level walkthrough of the apply flow in Workspace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learning Workspace Video Series for Organization Applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides step-by-step instructions for key actions within a Grants.gov workspace, including creating a workspace, adding participants, and completing forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Series targeted at organization applicants who collaborate on application packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Workflow for Organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlights the general workflow necessary to submit an application in Grants.gov Workspace where members of the same organization may simultaneously access and edit different forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains collaborative editing, sequence of actions, and submission responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: User Roles & Workspace Actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of the key roles and access levels that contribute to the Grants.gov workspace workflow for organization applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies which roles can perform which Workspace actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Create a Grants.gov Workspace
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how an applicant user can create a workspace for a specific funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step-by-step creation of a workspace tied to an opportunity; foundational for collaborative applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Add Participants to a Grants.gov Workspace
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the process of adding users, or Participants, to a workspace so multiple organization applicants can complete individual package forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers invitation/assignment of participants and participant permissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completing Forms in a Workspace on Grants.gov
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how federal grant application forms may be filled out as part of the Grants.gov workspace workflow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrates form entry, saving progress, and collaborative editing considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submitting an Application in Grants.gov Workspace
rubrics_metrics.description: Outlines the process of finalizing a completed application in Workspace and submitting it to the grant-making federal agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers final checks, locking/submitting forms, and transmission to the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quick Clicks Video Series for Grants.gov Workspace Users
rubrics_metrics.description: Short videos that walk organization applicants through important tasks relating to Grants.gov's workspace functionality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise, task-focused clips for common Workspace actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Viewing Form Attachments Within a Workspace
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how Grants.gov users can view PDF file attachments in their application forms within Workspace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrates locating and opening attached PDFs from within form entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Create Custom Roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how administrative users can create custom roles for use within Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance for tailoring role permissions beyond default role set.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I Add Participants Who Are Outside My Organization?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how users of Grants.gov's Workspace can add participants who are not part of their own organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure for including external collaborators in a Workspace.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adding Subforms in a Workspace
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how subforms can be added and managed in Grants.gov Workspace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows when and how to add subforms to application packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I Limit Access to Budget Forms?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how access to budget forms can be limited within Grants.gov Workspace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes mechanisms for restricting who can view/edit budget-related forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessing Webforms in a Workspace
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how applicants can view and edit webforms in a Grants.gov workspace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrates locating, opening, and editing agency webforms embedded in packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I Preview Forms in a Federal Grant Application?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how applicants can preview the forms in a federal grant application before downloading an application package or registering with Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps applicants inspect required fields and form structure in advance of completing or registering.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I Combine My Grants.gov Accounts?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how applicants can combine their Grants.gov accounts into a single account with multiple profiles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Step-by-step for merging accounts and managing multiple applicant profiles.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I Find Federal Grant Forecasts?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how applicants can locate federal grant forecasts on Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows where to find forecasted funding opportunities and interpret forecast information.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I Reuse Forms in a Workspace?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how applicants can save time by reusing forms across multiple workspaces set up by the same organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers copying or reusing previously completed form data to new workspaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I Reopen a Workspace?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how to reopen a Grants.gov workspace after an application has been submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes conditions and steps for reopening or retrieving workspace content post-submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reassigning Ownership of a Workspace
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how ownership of a Grants.gov workspace can be reassigned to another workspace participant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure for transferring primary workspace ownership and associated responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Why Should I Lock Forms in a Workspace?
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlights the importance of locking forms in order to protect applicants' ongoing work in a Grants.gov workspace.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains locking to prevent concurrent edits or accidental overwrites during finalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I Find Online Help Articles?
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains how users of Grants.gov's workspace functionality can access context-sensitive help articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points applicants to in-site help resources and article lookup strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I View the Grantor Image of My Application?
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduces the feature in Grants.gov Workspace that allows applicants to view their application just as the grant-making agency will view it (the grantor image).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this view to verify formatting and how the agency will receive submitted content.

rubrics_metrics.name: How Do I Preview Grantor Validations?
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduces the feature that allows applicants to check their application against validations in the grant-making agency's system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use preview validations to identify agency-specific errors before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help: Online User Guide
rubrics_metrics.description: The Grants.gov Online User Guide contains registration, search, and application instructions for all users, with a dedicated Applicants section for detailed applicant information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary textual documentation for in-depth procedures beyond videos.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant Overview / Grants.gov Applicant Overview Training Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: A training presentation covering everything applicants need to know about navigating Grants.gov as an Applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive slide-based overview suitable for onboarding new applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants.gov Organization Applicant Registration pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Step-by-step guide to organization applicant registration on Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed instructions for organization-level registration processes required to apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: SAM Quick Start Guide For Grantee Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Tool created by the General Services Administration to assist those registering with the System for Award Management (SAM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps applicants complete SAM registration; includes contact route for SAM support at fsd.gov.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help: Support Center (contact information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact the Grants.gov Support Center for assistance; email support@grants.gov or visit the Support page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary channel for troubleshooting technical or account issues not solved by guides/videos.
